items.zh: 修复 Codex 切不了同一账号的 Plus 和 Team 工作区
items.en: Fixed switching between Plus and Team workspaces of the same OpenAI account in Codex

items.zh: 额度可以改为显示「已用」，在设置 → 通用 → 外观里切换
items.en: Quotas can show what is used instead of what is left (Settings → General → Appearance)

items.zh: 可以压缩 Codex 历史会话，压缩后的会话照常显示和统计用量
items.en: Old Codex sessions can be compressed, and still show up with their usage counted

items.zh: 修复 Claude 1 小时缓存写入少算费用、部分中转站缓存命中显示为 0
items.en: Fixed under-billed Claude 1-hour cache writes and cache hits showing 0 on some relays
